title: Bug: Testbed health check fails on BMC testbeds due to incorrect critical container defaults
author: ediwibowo-msft
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

`.azure-pipelines/testbed_health_check.py` currently defaults critical containers to `syncd`, `swss`, and `bgp`. On BMC testbeds, those containers are not present, so the health check reports false failures even when the BMC system is healthy.

## Current BMC running containers
- `gnmi`
- `pmon`
- `telemetry`
- `sysmgr`
- `redfish`
- `acms`
- `database`

### Steps to Reproduce

1. Run `.azure-pipelines/testbed_health_check.py` against a BMC testbed.
2. Let `check_critical_containers_running()` use default container list.
3. Observe failure logs for missing `syncd/swss/bgp`.


### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

## Actual Result
Health check fails due to checking SONiC switch containers (`syncd/swss/bgp`) that do not exist on BMC.

## Expected Result
For BMC testbeds, default critical containers should match the BMC container set.

## Impact
- False-negative health checks on BMC environments.
- Potential testbed skip/failure in CI despite healthy BMC services.

## Proposed Fix
Detect BMC testbeds (for example by testbed name containing `bmc`) and switch default critical container list to:
- `gnmi`
- `pmon`
- `telemetry`
- `sysmgr`
- `redfish`
- `acms`
- `database`

## Additional Context
A local patch has already validated this direction by adding `is_bmc_testbed` logic and BMC-specific defaults in `.azure-pipelines/testbed_health_check.py`.

linkedPullRequests.body:
### Description of PR

Summary:
Fix BMC testbed health check false failures by using BMC-specific default critical containers instead of SONiC switch defaults.
Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/26192

### Type of change

- [x] Bug fix
- [x] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [ ] New Test case
- [ ] Skipped for non-supported platforms
- [ ] Test case improvement

### Back port request

- [ ] 202311

- [ ] 202411
- [ ] 202505
- [ ] 202511
- [ ] 202512
- [ ] 202605
- [x] 202608

Tracking issue/work item for backport/cherry-pick request:
None

Failure type:
other

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
BMC testbeds were failing health checks due to container validation expecting syncd/swss/bgp, which are not part of BMC container runtime. This caused false-negative health results and unnecessary pipeline failures/skips.

#### How did you do it?
Added BMC testbed detection in the health check flow and updated default critical container selection logic:
- Non-BMC testbeds keep existing defaults: syncd, swss, bgp
- BMC testbeds use: gnmi, pmon, telemetry, sysmgr, redfish, acms, database

#### How did you verify/test it?
- Verified script syntax by compiling the updated Python file.
- Validated logic path by checking BMC detection and container-list selection in the updated health-check code.
- Confirmed the expected BMC container set is now used for default validation.

#### Any platform specific information?
Yes. This change is specific to BMC testbeds and does not alter behavior for standard SONiC switch testbeds.

#### Supported testbed topology if it's a new test case?
Not a new test case.

### Documentation
No documentation update required. This is a health-check bug fix in existing testbed framework logic.

If you want, I can also generate a version with Fixes line left as a placeholder so you can fill the exact issue number later.
